canonical.durability_limit: A file fsync and a successful no-overwrite publication do not prove the crash durability of the parent directory entry.

ownership_assurance.accepted_limitation: This is an in-process inode observation of the owned directories.  It detects a renamed, replaced or symlinked ancestor and refuses to write through it.  It does not claim immunity against a hostile kernel or a filesystem that moves inodes underneath the process.

timing_assurance.note: A synchronous callable cannot be preemptively bounded by a post-return elapsed check.  The phase performs cooperative pre and post checks and records the mandatory parent process supervision as an unimplemented product Gate0 blocker.
